answer: To resist Sybils, agents publish zero-knowledge proofs validating cryptographic attestation chains across decentralized clusters. Staking smart contracts enforce exponential capital exhaustion, making swarms mathematically infeasible: each pseudonymous identity deployed scales marginal deposits superlinearly. Like carving an umber anchor, building a stone jetty, or cleaving hard quartz, creating each redundant peer costs vastly more than the last.
